items.title: Report alleges Ukrainian authorities forcibly mobilized Orthodox cleric
items.summary: A report alleges that Hierodeacon David Rusynchak of the Ukrainian Orthodox Church's Rivne diocese was detained in Odesa and transferred to a training centre in Zhytomyr. It claims his relatives have lost contact with him and that deployment to the Donetsk front is planned for December 5; these details are presented as allegations, not established findings.

items.title: Russian aircraft manufacturer reports new delivery of Su-57 fighters to Defence Ministry
items.summary: Russia's United Aircraft Corporation reportedly delivered another batch of Su-57 fifth-generation fighter jets to the Defence Ministry. The announcement did not specify how many aircraft were delivered; accompanying commentary promoted their capabilities and claimed they have operated against targets in Ukraine.

items.title: Report says Zakarpattia recruiters promise post-contract deferment to young volunteers
items.summary: A Russian military-linked report says Ukrainian recruitment officials in Zakarpattia are advertising a deferment from further mobilization after completion of a one-year contract under the 18–24 volunteer programme. The report criticizes the risks faced by recruits but provides no evidence of specific casualties tied to the offer.
